checkRuns.command: mkdir -p app/layouts app/pages/books app/composables app/components && cat > nuxt.config.ts <<'E' export default defineNuxtConfig({ compatibilityDate: '2025-07-15', modules: ['@nuxt/content'], devtools: { enabled: false } }) E cat > content.config.ts <<'E' import { defineCollection, defineContentConfig, z } from '@nuxt/content' export default defineContentConfig({ collections: { books: defineCollection({ type: 'page', source: 'books/*.md', schema: z.object({ title: z.string(), author: z.string(), year: z.number(), rating: z.number(), tags: z.array(z.string()) }) }) } }) E cat > app/app.vue <<'E' E cat > app/error.vue <<'E' E cat > app/layouts/default.vue <<'E' E cat > app/composables/useFavorites.ts <<'E' const KEY = 'bookshelf:favorites' export function useFavorites() { const favorites = useState('favorites', () => []) const loaded = useState('favorites-loaded', () => false) if (import.meta.client && !loaded.value) { loaded.value = true onNuxtReady(() => { try { favorites.value = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]') } catch { favorites.value = [] } }) } function isFavorite(slug: string) { return favorites.value.includes(slug) } function toggle(slug: string) { favorites.value = isFavorite(slug) ? favorites.value.filter(s => s !== slug) : [...favorites.value, slug] localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(favorites.value)) } return { favorites, isFavorite, toggle } } E cat > app/pages/index.vue <<'E' E cat > app/pages/about.vue <<'E' E cat > app/pages/books/index.vue <<'E' E cat > app/pages/books/[slug].vue <<'E' E cat > app/pages/contact.vue <<'E'
